phase: Phase 12: Advanced Convoy Mesh, Forward-Secret Key Ratchet & Live Activity

stories.title: Pure KMP Perfect Forward Secrecy (PFS) & Ephemeral Key Ratchet Engine
stories.description: Implement pure Kotlin multiplatform Double-Ratchet / Ephemeral Key Rotation engine (MeshKeyRatchet.kt) for mesh channels: derive rolling ephemeral session keys from master group secret using pure Kotlin HKDF-SHA256, maintain out-of-order packet decryption key cache with replay protection, and support out-of-band RATCHET_ADVANCE control frames.
acceptanceCriteria: Pure Kotlin Multiplatform with zero Java (java.security.*) or C/JNI dependencies (Rule 3)
Key ratchet advances automatically every N packets or time window while supporting out-of-order packet arrival
Previous session keys are securely cleared from memory guaranteeing forward secrecy
100% test pass on JVM and compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64 (Rule 6)

stories.title: Direct Helmet Intercom Bluetooth GATT Accessory Profile (Cardo / Sena / EJEAS)
stories.description: Implement specialized Bluetooth Low Energy GATT client profile (HelmetAccessoryManager.kt) for direct motorcycle helmet intercom communication: Cardo, Sena, and EJEAS handlebar remote PTT button listening, battery level telemetry reporting, and SCO/A2DP audio link fallback management.
acceptanceCriteria: Pure KMP contract with platform-agnostic GATT characteristic UUID definitions
Detects and parses remote PTT click/press/release events from handlebar remotes and helmet dials
Streams accessory battery percentage and connection status to HomeUiState and IntercomViewModel
Full unit test suite verifying accessory discovery, event dispatch, and disconnect handling

stories.title: iOS 18+ Live Activity & Dynamic Island Hands-Free PTT Widget
stories.description: Implement 100% native iOS Live Activity and Dynamic Island interactive cockpit widget (IntercomActivityWidget.swift) using ActivityKit and WidgetKit: compact leading/trailing indicators, expanded view with large hands-on PTT touch trigger, active rider radar bearing, and emergency alert card.
acceptanceCriteria: 100% Native SwiftUI / WidgetKit implementation adhering to Rule 1 (zero shared Compose on iOS)
Dynamic Island displays real-time active channel, transmitting rider, and RF link margin
Lock Screen Live Activity provides instant 1-tap channel switch and SOS trigger
ActivityKit lifecycle tied cleanly to active intercom session via IntercomBridge

stories.title: Multi-Cluster Cloud Cross-Mesh SFU Signaling & Audio Bridging
stories.description: Extend :core signaling protocol and :server Ktor SFU audio bridge to interconnect multiple independent BLE mesh clusters: SignalingMessage.ClusterBridge, transcode-free routing of 4-bit ADPCM packets with jitter smoothing, and multi-cluster peer presence aggregation.
acceptanceCriteria: SignalingProtocol registers ClusterBridge polymorphic message type with #type discriminator
SignalingServerManager routes audio frames across rooms without audio transcoding or latency penalty
CloudRelayBridge aggregates cross-cluster peer presence and prevents routing loops
